profile.campus: Data4 Warsaw campus, Jawczyce, Poland (WAW1 and WAW2, combined ~4 hectares / 60 MW per Data4 own site)
profile.reading:
WAW2 is DATA4's second Polish data center, at the same Przyparkowa 21 address in Jawczyce, a village in the Ożarów Mazowiecki municipality about 20 minutes from central Warsaw, sharing a campus with the earlier WAW1 building. DATA4, the French headquartered developer and operator behind both buildings, launched WAW2 on April 9, 2026, according to Polish trade press, adding 10 megawatts of IT power to the campus. DATA4's Poland entity, DATA4 Poland Sp. z o.o., registered in the Polish national court register under number 0000870360 since November 30, 2020, is based at this same Przyparkowa 21 address and is wholly owned by DATA4 Services Poland Sp. z o.o.

Trade coverage of the WAW2 launch reported the building achieved BREEAM Excellent certification, described in that coverage as the first data center in Poland to do so, alongside a measured power usage effectiveness of 1.27 and a water usage figure of 0.037 liters per kilowatt hour of IT load, framed as meeting the data center industry's 2030 efficiency targets ahead of schedule. The same coverage said DATA4 has invested about 200 million euros in Poland to date and plans to nearly triple that to around 600 million euros by 2030, a program expected to support roughly 400 direct and indirect jobs, and noted DATA4's participation in an EU funded research initiative on data center climate adaptation. DATA4's own current Warsaw campus page states the finished WAW1 and WAW2 campus will total about 4 hectares and roughly 60 megawatts of available IT power, without a building by building breakdown, so WAW2's 10 megawatt figure sits inside, rather than in addition to, that eventual campus total.

No Polish environmental decision document and no Ożarów Mazowiecki gmina level planning file specific to WAW2 was located on the municipal public information bulletin or through a search of Polish environmental review terminology during this research. An October 2025 agreement between DATA4 and the Ożarów Mazowiecki municipal government, fully funded by DATA4, to repave and light Przyparkowa street between its junction with Sadowa street and the S8 highway overpass, is the clearest local government record found connecting the company to this specific location, and the Poland director's quote in that announcement referred to DATA4 continuing to build additional data centers at the site, without naming a next building or a date.

DATA4's global ownership has changed twice since WAW1 first opened in 2023. AXA Investment Managers Alternatives sold DATA4 to Brookfield Infrastructure for 2.4 billion dollars in a deal completed August 2023, and in August 2025 Brookfield brought in Arjun Infrastructure Partners and Interogo Holding as new shareholders. DATA4's own press release on that August 2025 transaction names Paris, Milan, and Madrid, not Warsaw, as the cities in the divested 244 megawatt stabilised portfolio, consistent with Poland remaining one of the company's newer, still expanding markets. No tenant name for WAW2 was found in any source reviewed, and no standby generator, utility interconnection, or onsite generation figure specific to this building was found published anywhere.

profile.research_note: Rewritten 2026-09-05: prior version carried a stale 2019-era AXA-only ownership claim. Extended ownership history through the April 2023/August 2023 Brookfield acquisition and the August 2025 Arjun Infrastructure Partners / Interogo Holding stake sale, sourced to DATA4 own press release, noting that release names only Paris, Milan and Madrid, not Warsaw, in the divested stabilised portfolio. Added WAW2 10MW IT power figure, BREEAM Excellent cert, PUE 1.27, and water usage figure from Polish trade press (mamstartup.pl) covering the April 9 2026 launch, and confirmed the Data4 Poland Sp. z o.o. KRS registration (0000870360, since Nov 2020) at this exact address via Polish national court register data. Searched Ożarów Mazowiecki gmina BIP and Polish environmental-review terminology (decyzja środowiskowa, karta informacyjna przedsięwzięcia) for a facility-specific environmental decision or PSE grid interconnection filing, found none this session, recorded here as an explicit gap rather than left silent. No banned aggregator used as a source.
profile.campus_power_note: The four power numbers for DATA4's Warsaw campus need to stay separate because only IT power figures were found published, and no campus wide building count total was found. DATA4's own current Warsaw page states the finished WAW1 and WAW2 campus will total about 60 megawatts of available IT power across roughly 4 hectares, without a building by building breakdown. Trade press reported WAW1's IT power at 8 megawatts when it opened in May 2023, and WAW2's IT power at 10 megawatts when it launched in April 2026, together 18 megawatts committed against that 60 megawatt campus target, implying further building phases beyond WAW1 and WAW2 that no source reviewed this session named or dated, so campus_buildings_total is left unset rather than guessed. No standby generator rating, utility grid interconnection figure, or onsite generation figure was found published for this campus in any DATA4, Polish grid operator, or municipal source located during this research.
